fusions.name: Torn Free
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: your barbed tongue snags it up to 4 tiles away and deals 8 damage, using the affliction up and adding half its remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Barb Flung Wide
fusions.desc: A barb flung at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hauled Along
fusions.desc: Your tongue hooks the ground ahead and hauls you 6 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Barbed Tally
fusions.desc: Every hit you land hooks that enemy, up to 5 times. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the barbs tear free and strike it for 34% of your weapon damage per barb (170% at full). Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.
